QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] The Mistrustful King
QuestInfo.0: Queen #p2161001# is weeping in her castle, the castle ruled by the transformed Lion King. Who is the Lion King? Has he forgotten about #p2161001#?
QuestInfo.1: #p2161001# wants you to go to the #bAudience Room#k to meet the #bLion King#k, since he doesn't seem to hear her. She'd like you to deliver her message to him. How will the Lion King react to the news of his wife? Use #p2161001# to get to the Lion King.
QuestInfo.2: The Lion King is furious and tells you not to lie, as Queen #p2161001# died a long time ago. Since he hasn't forgotten about #p2161001#, he really must not hear her voice.

0.0: I've been watching this castle for hundreds of years, but I still can't believe my eyes. It used to be so beautiful. Seeing this place in all its glory used to warm my heart...
0.1: And the same goes for the king. Leon... He was a master swordsman, but he was still so warm-hearted and kind. He didn't speak much, but I could feel his generous heart. How could he have changed like that...
0.2: What has the #rBlack Mage#k done to him? Why has he become so...? Has he forgotten about me?  Please...could you speak to Leon for me?

yes.0: He's not answering my voice, but I'm certain that he's in the #bAudience Room#k. Please find out whether #bLeon#k remembers me or not, and if he does, why he isn't answering me.

no.0: I'm sorry... He'll probably attack anyone who enters the Audience Room. That's a lot to ask of you, I'm sure.

1.0: What are you doing here? Are you here to fight? No? What is it that you want then? Hm? Do I remember Queen #p2161001#? How dare you? I'll not permit you to speak her name.\r\n#L0##bI met her. #p2161001# has become a ghost, and she's been calling you. But she is saddened that you're not answering her.#l\n#k
1.1: Silence! Don't you lie to me! If she were a ghost, I would know. Speak her name again, and I will destroy you. Do you really wish to fight me?

npc.0: Haven't you seen #bLeon#k yet? You can find him in the #bAudience Room#k. It's dangerous to go alone... Maybe you should bring friends.
